newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end down on fund injection.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end down on fund injection.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed down further on Thursday as liquidity eased following the central bank's persistent fund injections, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate dropped to 8.240 percent against Wednesday's 8.601 end -- but still well above the central bank's previously declared 5.0-5.5 percent target zone.
The 30-day commercial paper fell to 7.50 against 7.75-8.00.
The central bank injected T$4 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations following days of such injections to alleviate tight liquidity.
Dealers expected the money rates to fall further.
In the bond market, the benchmark 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1070 percent.
